name: nasiko-support-agent
description: Answers questions about using Nasiko itself. How-to: where a setting lives and how to do a task, such as deploying an agent from a zip, GitHub or a registry, what an agent zip must contain, versions, logs, secrets, chat and the orchestrator, workflows, the LLM router, MCP servers and tool permissions, approvals, sessions, flows and traces, TokenOps costs and budgets, coding harnesses, access control and the CLI. It replies with the exact menu path, numbered steps, the matching `nasiko` CLI command and a link to docs.nasiko.com. Troubleshooting: paste an error, a build log or `nasiko logs` output and it matches known failures (zip layout, corrupt zip, version already exists, 502 from chat, expired CLI login, rejected provider key, missing dependency, wrong port, GitHub or MCP server not connected, stuck pending) to a likely cause and fix, asking at most two short questions first. It answers only from its bundled Nasiko notes, never invents a menu or command, and says so when something isn't in its notes. It only explains: it can't see your agents or change anything. Not for general coding or other topics. Notes as of 2026-11-12.

skills.name: Nasiko how-to and troubleshooting
skills.description: Where to click and which `nasiko` command to run for a Nasiko task, and the likely cause and fix for an agent that won't build, start or answer, from the error text you paste. Answers cite docs.nasiko.com.
examples: How do I upload an agent, and what should the zip contain?
My agent isn't working, what do I do?
How do I configure the LLM router?
